chunks.subject: AP European History
chunks.title: SAQ 2 — Primary Source (3 points) — Set 1
chunks.content: AP European History SAQ 2 (Primary Source), 3 points, one per part. Set 1 prompts (an engraving): A [1] describe a likely intended purpose of the engraving; B [1] describe a broader historical context for the events depicted; C [1] explain one way that events such as those referenced affected European society/politics. 'Describe' = relevant characteristics; 'Explain' = how/why. Common failure: A describing the content instead of the purpose (why it was made / intended effect on audience); C describing rather than explaining an effect.

chunks.subject: AP European History
chunks.title: SAQ 2 Set 1 exemplar — Sample 2A, 3/3
chunks.content: SAQ 2 (Set 1) scored 3/3 (A 1, B 1, C 1). Described a likely intended purpose of the engraving, gave a broader historical context, and explained an effect of such events. Full-credit model.

chunks.subject: AP European History
chunks.title: SAQ 2 Set 1 exemplar — Sample 2B, 2/3
chunks.content: SAQ 2 (Set 1) scored 2/3 (A 1, B 1, C 0). Described the engraving's purpose (A) and a broader context (B) but did not explain an effect of such events (C) — the causal 'how' was missing. Illustrates the common pattern of losing the Explain part.

chunks.subject: AP European History
chunks.title: SAQ 2 Set 1 exemplar — Sample 2C, 1/3
chunks.content: SAQ 2 (Set 1) scored 1/3 (A 1, B 0, C 0). Described a likely purpose of the engraving only. Lost B (no valid broader context) and C (no causal explanation). Illustrates a response that reads the source's purpose but supplies neither context nor an explained effect.
